meta.name: migrate-to-shoehorn
meta.description: Migrate test files from `as` type assertions to @total-typescript/shoehorn. Use when user mentions shoehorn, wants to replace `as` in tests, or needs partial test data.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将测试中的 `as` 类型断言迁移为 shoehorn 工具
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果测试代码中大量使用 `as` 类型断言需要迁移
copy.tagline_en: Migrate `as` type assertions in tests to shoehorn
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to replace `as` type assertions in tests with shoehorn

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会帮你把测试代码中的 `as` 类型断言替换成 `@total-typescript/shoehorn` 提供的类型安全函数，比如 `fromPartial()` 和 `fromAny()`。
howto.when: 当你提到“shoehorn”、想替换测试中的 `as` 断言，或需要部分测试数据时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个测试文件里的 `as Request` 换成 shoehorn。
say.note: Claude 会安装 shoehorn 并替换断言。

say.text: 用 `fromPartial` 改写这个测试，只传 body.id。
say.note: Claude 会生成只包含必要属性的测试数据。

say.text: 这个测试需要故意传错误类型，用 `fromAny` 替换。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will help you replace `as` type assertions in test files with type-safe functions from `@total-typescript/shoehorn`, such as `fromPartial()` and `fromAny()`.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "shoehorn", want to replace `as` in tests, or need partial test data.

say_en.text: Replace `as Request` with shoehorn in this test file.
say_en.note: Claude will install shoehorn and replace assertions.

say_en.text: Rewrite this test using `fromPartial`, only pass body.id.
say_en.note: Claude will generate test data with only necessary properties.

say_en.text: This test needs intentionally wrong data, use `fromAny`.
say_en.note: Claude will use `fromAny` for deliberately incorrect data.
